implementation: Original Apache-2.0 CPU metadata backend; not copied from D-Ogi or Linux full functions
four_level_layout: Bounded PDB2/PDB1/PDB0/PTB subset; 9-bit indices; 4KiB leaves; system DMA numeric NC codec only
ownership: Metadata allocated by trusted caller callbacks with context identity, strict level and unique parent/slot
directories: CPU pointers, not encoded PDEs or GPU-visible DMA tables
transaction: Caller-exclusive, <=64 unique consecutive VA pages; prepare all paths before leaf commit; restore old leaves before freeing newly allocated nodes
